title: GazeFlow: From Human Gaze Behavior to Generative Egocentric Gaze Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2609.38519v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Egocentric gaze prediction enables many downstream applications but remains challenging, as human gaze is inherently stochastic. This stochasticity is constrained by structured temporal dynamics alternating between fixations and saccades, top-down influences from tasks, and bottom-up visual saliency. Based on this observation, we introduce GazeFlow, a framework that directly models gaze as a joint distribution of temporal gaze positions conditioned upon both top-down and bottom-up information. In particular, GazeFlow uses conditional flow matching (CFM): a learned velocity field iteratively transports a Gaussian noise sample into a plausible gaze trajectory drawn from this joint distribution. The velocity field is conditioned on bottom-up visual features extracted by a video encoder and on top-down task information obtained by globally querying these features. translated_title: GazeFlow：从人类注视行为到生成式第一人称注视预测
translated_abstract: 第一人称（自我中心）注视预测能够支持许多下游应用，但仍然具有挑战性，因为人类注视本质上是随机的。这种随机性受到结构化时间动态（在注视驻留与扫视之间交替）、自上而下的任务影响以及自下而上的视觉显著性的约束。基于这一观察，我们提出了GazeFlow，一个将注视直接建模为以自上而下和自下而上信息为条件的时间注视位置联合分布的框架。具体而言，GazeFlow采用条件流匹配（CFM）：一个学习到的速度场迭代地将高斯噪声样本输运为从该联合分布中抽取的合理注视轨迹。该速度场以视频编码器提取的自下而上视觉特征，以及通过全局查询这些特征获得的自上而下任务信息为条件。在标准数据集上，GazeFlow在每个……（原文在此截断）方面取得了最先进的性能。
tldr: 提出GazeFlow框架，利用条件流匹配将第一人称注视建模为受自上而下任务信息与自下而上视觉显著性共同约束的时间注视位置联合分布，从而生成合理的注视轨迹并达到最先进的预测性能。
en_tdlr: GazeFlow models egocentric gaze as a joint distribution of temporal gaze positions conditioned on top-down task information and bottom-up visual saliency via conditional flow matching, generating plausible gaze trajectories and achieving state-of-the-art prediction performance.
